purpose: Separates donor discovery/approval from actual LiOS implementation, packaging, user accessibility and release proof.

integrationPolicy.goal: Review every registered entry and integrate every suitable donor through existing canonical LiOS authorities.
integrationPolicy.baselineAccounting: The donors array preserves exactly the 92 baseline IDs, including overlapping upstream entries. Additional components are accounted for separately, never silently counted as a 93rd baseline donor.
integrationPolicy.creativeReusePolicy: No arbitrary exploration or useful-import ceiling. Investigate repurposing functionality beyond its original purpose and combining whole useful subsystems for LiOS.
integrationPolicy.newScopePolicy: Present new product-scope proposals to the owner; never silently reject or silently approve them.
integrationPolicy.zeroSetupTarget: Normal users must not manually install donor runtimes, Python servers or renderer dependencies. LiOS provisions/verifies internal components; heavy optional assets require visible size/rights/consent. Today's external Ollama provider, optional missing browser runtime and nonintegrated engine/output/renderers are delivery gaps, not exemptions from this target.

overlapGroups.rule: Preserve both entries; one canonical chart integration, not duplicate installations.

integrationPolicy.truthRule: SI-01..SI-07 define strategic execution; S0..S10 are validation journeys and CP records are historical evidence. This policy records owner intent, not suitability approval, implementation, Shipping Point acceptance or shipped evidence.
integrationPolicy.legacyRejectionReview: Domain-only, initial-scope or overlap-only reasons are historical decisions, not final REJECT_WITH_EVIDENCE dispositions. Mechanism, repurposing, combination and challenger review remains pending where no concrete evidence is recorded; rights prohibitions and singular canonical authorities remain in force.

It does not replace the scored Global Instrument Master name/identifier resolver; no P5 identity state is delegated to it. Deferred, not rejected: reconsider for bulk reconciliation of provider catalogs / holdings imports (S4) behind the same P5 candidate contract, with ambiguity surfaced by LiOS, after the labelled no-ticker corpus (roadmap 0.0.13 F) exists.
